name: Project Outbreak Zombies
author: Project Outbreak
summary: A custom zombie sandbox including slow, fast, and crawling Zombies.
description:
Project Outbreak aims to enhance the Zombie experience in Arma Reforger. It includes various Zombie archetypes (slow, fast, crawling), animations, and ways to customize Zombie health and damage.


Place them directly through Game Master or use ambient populations and directed waves to shape an entire scenario.

changelog:
1.3.3
- The Nephilim now nearly always grabs and throws someone he closes on, instead of sometimes only hitting them. Game Masters can set how often this happens in the world settings.
- A thrown man no longer hangs in the air for a moment after the Nephilim has already thrown him.
- Automatic respawn no longer picks a faction nobody can play as. On some scenarios that left a player with no body at all.
- A soldier who dies in a vehicle stays in the seat again and can be pulled out with Remove Casualty. Before, the body fell through the vehicle and blocked the seat for good.
- Zombifying someone who sits in a vehicle now gets them out first, so they turn on the ground beside it.
